errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the order of the bars within each group. It lists all 'ARC-JSD' bars first, followed by all 'Contextcite' bars. The actual order in the chart is alternating: ARC-JSD - TyDi QA, then Contextcite - TyDi QA; ARC-JSD - Hotpot QA, then Contextcite - Hotpot QA; and so on.

The description labels the 'Contextcite - TyDi QA' bar as 'dark orange'. In the legend and the chart, this bar is a standard orange, not noticeably darker than the other orange bars, and distinct from the lighter orange shades.

The description mentions the y-axis range goes up to 100, but the visible tick labels on the chart only go up to 80. While the highest bar is near 90, stating the implied range as up to 90 would be more accurate than 100.
